name: RTMPose
plain: OpenMMLab's RTMPose (t, s, m, l; 256x192 and 384x288): real-time top-down 2D human pose, a CSPNeXt CNN with a SimCC head; also the whole-body DWPose and RTMW checkpoints (133 keypoints with feet, face and hands); Halpe (26 keypoints), hand, face and animal checkpoints. Apache-2.0.
summary: RTMPose (Jiang et al. 2023): real-time top-down 2D human pose from OpenMMLab: a CSPNeXt CNN backbone and a SimCC head (a gated attention unit over one token per keypoint, then x and y classified as 1D bins at half-pixel resolution, no heatmaps). The body7 checkpoints (trained on seven public pose datasets) return the 17 COCO keypoints; the DWPose ones (Yang et al. 2023, distilled on COCO-WholeBody + UBody, the pose model of ControlNet's openpose preprocessors) the 133 COCO-WholeBody keypoints (body, feet, face, both hands). The RTMW ones (Jiang et al. 2024: a PAFPN neck and a two-scale head on the same backbone, trained on 14 datasets) return the same 133 keypoints more accurately. More model-zoo checkpoints of the same network: `-halpe26` (body + feet, 26 keypoints), `-hand5` (21 keypoints of a hand box), `-face6` (106 face landmarks of a face box) and `-ap10k` (17 keypoints of an animal box). Takes person boxes (e.g. from `fastforks.detection`) and crops each at 256 x 192 (or 384 x 288; hand, face and animal boxes: 256 x 256); vendored from mmpose (no mmpose / mmcv dependency). The portable `module()` maps crops to SimCC logits.

papers.title: RTMPose: Real-Time Multi-Person Pose Estimation based on MMPose
Effective Whole-body Pose Estimation with Two-stages Distillation

task_io: Input: one RGB image and a box per person. Output: keypoints with confidence scores for every person.

variants.name: rtmpose-t

licence.training_note: body7: COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18 keypoints; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k (and on the same pose data, `pt-body7`)

quality.title: COCO val2017, ground-truth person boxes, keypoint AP
quality.protocol: Top-down on the ground-truth person boxes (non-crowd, at least one labelled keypoint), no flip test; people ranked by the mean of their 17 keypoint scores (not mmpose's rescoring and OKS-NMS), so not the papers' AP; pycocotools OKS AP; whole-body models scored on their 17 body keypoints.
